title: Burgundy and gold Christmas: velvet ornaments, pearls and a knit tree skirt
seoTitle: Burgundy Christmas Tree Ideas Philippines 2026: Velvet Ornaments and Gold
dek: 6 hand-picked pieces for the 2026 burgundy-and-gold look: soft velvet baubles, pearl garland, gold chargers for the Noche Buena table and a cozy knit tree skirt.
teaser: Velvet baubles, pearls and gold for an elegant wine-red Christmas tree.
description: Burgundy and gold Christmas tree ideas for Filipino homes: burgundy velvet ornament sets, flocked tassel ornaments, pearl bead garland, gold charger plates and a knit tree skirt, with prices and styling tips.

intro: Want a Christmas tree that still feels festive but isn't the usual red and green? Try burgundy and gold. Christmasworld, the big seasonal decor trade fair in Frankfurt, calls one of its 2026 trends "Festive Opulence": cream, wine red and burgundy, paired with gold and metallic finishes, plus details like pearl embellishments. It reads rich and grown-up, it photographs beautifully, and it makes a Noche Buena-ready sala feel a little more special.

We grouped Sam's picks two ways. First, burgundy velvet ornaments: a big mixed set, a boxed dozen and a statement tasseled piece. Then the finishing touches: a gold bead garland, a gold charger plate for the Noche Buena table and a knit tree skirt to ground it all. Sizes, colors and pieces per order can differ by variant, so check each listing before you add to cart.

tipGroups.title: Four tips for a burgundy and gold Christmas

tips.title: Stick to a short color list
tips.body: Pick burgundy as your main color, add cream or white for contrast, and use gold as the shine. Christmasworld's Festive Opulence palette pairs cream, wine red and burgundy with gold and metallic finishes, so a tight palette like this looks planned, not random.

tips.title: Mix textures, not just colors
tips.body: Velvet balls next to glossy gold beads and a chunky knit skirt give the tree depth even in one color family. Christmasworld also names knitted textiles and velvety flocked finishes among 2026's soft, cozy decor details.

tips.title: Keep candles away from fabric decor
tips.body: Velvet ornaments, ribbons, tassels and knit skirts are all fabric. Keep lit candles away from decorations and anything that can burn, and turn off light strings before you go to bed or leave the house.
tips.source: NFPA: Winter Holiday Safety tip sheet

tips.title: Hang ornaments securely, especially with kids around
tips.body: Make sure every ornament is secured to a branch, since even high ones can still fall. With little kids at home, keep small or breakable pieces up high and out of reach.

sections.name: Burgundy velvet ornaments
sections.alt: AI sample render of a slim Christmas tree covered in burgundy and cream velvet baubles with gold accents, beside a cream sofa
sections.definition: Velvet and flocked ornaments have a soft, matte, fabric-like surface instead of a shiny one, so burgundy looks deep and plush rather than bright. They're the base of this look: hang them all over the tree, then let gold and cream pieces do the sparkling.
sections.shoppingList: Soft, deep-red baubles that make the whole tree look rich.
tips: Hang the biggest burgundy balls deep inside the branches first, then work outward; it makes the tree look fuller.
Spread the color evenly by stepping back every few ornaments and filling any empty patch.
Brush off dust gently with a soft dry brush when you pack them away, and store them in their box so the velvet doesn't get crushed.

sections.name: Pearls, gold and a knit skirt
sections.alt: AI sample render of a tree draped in pearl garland on a burgundy knit skirt, with a dining table set with gold charger plates
sections.definition: These pieces finish the look: a gold bead garland that winds through the branches, a gold charger plate to carry the theme to the Noche Buena table, and a cable-knit skirt that hides the tree stand and adds a soft, cozy base.
sections.shoppingList: The shine on top and the cozy base below.
tips: Drape garland loosely in swoops from top to bottom, rather than wrapping it tight around the tree.
Repeat one gold piece on the dinner table so the sala and the Noche Buena spread look like one theme.
Keep a skirt and any fabric decor clear of heaters, lamps and candles.
